releaseNotes:
### 14.4.9

* Adds the GdPictureDocumentConverter properties TiffEnableExifRotate and EmailPreferOnePage to the COM edition. (J#GDPIC-1638)
* Adds the PdfNoDocumentLoaded status, returned by PDF methods called before a document is loaded instead of GenericError. (J#NAT-608)
* Improves Word (DOCX) to PDF conversion performance, reducing processing time and memory usage. (J#MAMBO-2090)
* Improves error codes for annotation, imaging and PDF reduction failures that previously reported a generic error. (J#NAT-608)
* Improves error codes for common runtime failures, returning specific statuses such as InvalidParameter and WrongState. (J#NAT-606)
* Improves error codes for printing, annotation XMP export, and page-layout operations on non-PDF documents. (J#NAT-608)
* Improves error codes returned by the SDK, resolving internal exceptions to specific statuses instead of a generic error. (J#NAT-604)
* Improves heuristic PDF layout extraction.
* Improves HTML to PDF conversion engine. (J#NAT-97)
* Improves Instant JSON imports. (J#NAT-395)
* Improves PDF to Markdown conversion quality with two-pass processing and additional refinements.
* Improves performance of PDF font embedding across conversion processes.
* Improves the office->pdf speed tests. (J#MAMBO-2073)
* Moves WPF and WinForms viewers into separate NuGet packages. (J#GDPIC-1580)
* Fixes process crashes when several threads register a license key or evaluate a licensed feature at the same time. (L#GDPIC-1655)
* Fixes the licensing banner and licensed feature list being printed to the console once a production license key is registered. (L#GDPIC-1622)
* Fixes the paragraph alignment being lost or mirrored when converting right-to-left Word 97-2003 documents. (J#MAMBO-2114)
* Fixes .NET 10 toolbox support for WinForms and WPF viewer controls. (J#GDPIC-1594)
* Fixes a licensing initialization crash on 32-bit Windows and garbled log output encoding. (GDPIC-1612)
* Fixes a telemetry serialization exception that could propagate to the caller. (J#GDPIC-1617)
* Fixes an issue related to the COM environment. (J#GDPIC-1596)
* Fixes an issue related to the strong name signing assmebly. (J#GDPIC-1611)
* Fixes function loading issue. (J#GDPDF-1509)
* Fixes GdPicture.NET.Toolkit NuGet package on .NET Framework 4.6.2 by including native runtimes as a package dependency. (J#GDPIC-1619)
* Fixes loss of image alternate text (description) when converting documents to PDF-UA. (J#PDFA-93)
* Fixes missing file extension for message/delivery-status attachments extracted from EML files. (J#GDPIC-1618)
* Fixes the annotations of the displayed page being rendered on every ThumbnailEx thumbnail on .NET 8 and later.
* Fixes right-aligned shape text and list numbers being rendered left-aligned in documents that specify alignment with the start and end values rather than left and right. (J#MAMBO-2114)

#### Barcode

* Improves QR code recognition on damaged barcodes when only two finder patterns are available. (J#GDBC-497)

#### Imaging

* Adds an opt-in OMR setting that derives the black and white threshold from the form, so marks lighter than solid black are no longer discarded. (J#GDPIC-1640)
* Optimizes the raster operators used by DrawGdPictureImageOP and DrawFilledRectangleOP with SIMD.
* Fixes unbounded native memory growth in long-running services caused by compression work buffers being retained per thread. (J#DV-774)
* Fixes the barcode reader and 1-bpp conversion methods throwing a NullReferenceException under memory pressure instead of returning a status code; all Barcode*ReaderDoScan and ConvertTo1Bpp* methods now return the appropriate status, such as OutOfMemory, when an intermediate image cannot be allocated. (J#MAMBO-2114)
* Fixes an error when creating high-quality thumbnails with XMP annotation burning enabled on .NET 8. (J#DV-770)
* Fixes annotations misplaced on images whose orientation is stored as metadata, when viewed, printed or flattened. (J#GDPIC-1547)
* Fixes loading of standalone JBIG2 (.jb2) image files, including multipage files. (L#GDPIC-1656)
* Fixes TIFF merging when the destination file already exists. (J#GDPIC-1628)

#### Ocr

* Improves chart data extraction in VLM-enhanced document analysis: charts are now always routed to the vision model, and their data is re-extracted with a dedicated full-resolution pass so multi-series, stacked, and diverging charts yield a usable data table. (J#NAVI-34)
* Improves table and chart recognition accuracy in AI-powered document analysis.
* Activates the Auto acceleration mode for document analysis inference: a compatible GPU is selected first, otherwise inference runs on the CPU. (J#NAT-558)
* Changes the default local vision model to a higher-accuracy configuration for chart and figure extraction. It needs more memory than the previous default, so configure a smaller compatible model in the custom VLM API settings on constrained hardware. (J#NAVI-34)
* Fixes OCR text layer placement on multi-page PDFs when threaded OCR is enabled. (J#NAT-409)

#### Office

* Adds support for wrapping text on the left, right, or largest side of shapes when converting Word, RTF, and OpenDocument files to PDF. (J#MAMBO-2038)
* Adds direct DOCX to Markdown conversion. (J#MAMBO-2049)
* Adds Office fidelity tests. (J#MAMBO-2036)
* Adds rendering of DisplayBarCode QR code fields in Word documents during conversion. (J#MAMBO-2058)
* Adds rendering of form checkboxes and dropdowns from ODT documents during conversion. (J#MAMBO-2072)
* Adds rendering of straight line connectors when converting OpenDocument files to PDF. (J#MAMBO-2038)
* Adds support for flat OPC PowerPoint and Word documents. (J#MAMBO-2052)
* Adds support for ordinal date fields. (J#MAMBO-2008)
* Adds PDF boormark source option for Office-to-PDF conversion. (J#MAMBO-2043)
* Improves DOCX line spacing rendition for documents using the legacy line spacing compatibility option. (J#MAMBO-2027)
* Improves DOCX rendition of trailing line breaks to match Word line height behavior. (J#MAMBO-2057)
* Improves footnote pagination: splits over-long footnotes across pages and renders footnotes from tables full-width. (J#MAMBO-2096, J#MAMBO-2047)
* Improves ODT to PDF page dimension rendition to match Microsoft Word. (J#MAMBO-2059)
* Improves pagination of floating block in Office documents headers and footers. (J#MAMBO-1994)
* Improves parsing empty spaces from ODT documents. (J#MAMBO-2075)
* Improves parsing fields over multiple content. (J#MAMBO-2017, J#MAMBO-2019)
* Improves rendering of hidden paragraphs from Office documents. (J#MAMBO-2013)
* Improves rendition of DOC(X) files. (J#MAMBO-2044)
* Improves rendition of footnotes and endnotes from Office documents. (J#MAMBO-2021)
* Improves rendition of graphic objects from Office documents. (J#MAMBO-2015)
* Improves rendition of pie chart plot area sizing, legend alignment, and data label backgrounds to match Microsoft Office. (J#MAMBO-1949)
* Improves rendition of text shadow and outline effects in Word documents. (J#MAMBO-2028)
* Improves rendition of the kerning property in documents. (J#MAMBO-2048)
* Improves renditions on line numbering from Office document. (J#MAMBO-1987)
* Improves the speed and memory usage of XLSX to PDF conversion. (J#MAMBO-2102)
* Improves the Office-to-PDF conversion benchmark with stable per-file timing and a memory-profiling mode. (J#MAMBO-2093)
* Improves memory consumption when rendering Excel files. (J#MAMBO-1926)
* Optimizes memory usage when converting spreadsheets to PDF, reducing processing time, peak memory and allocations for large sheets. (J#MAMBO-2022)
* Upgrades OpenMcdf to 3.1.3 to fix a denial-of-service vulnerability when parsing crafted MSG files (CVE-2026-41511).
* Fixes PDF conversion stopping prematurely on bookmarks and links processing. (J#MAMBO-2051)
* Fixes a crash when converting certain Word documents with multi-column sections to PDF. (J#MAMBO-2106)
* Fixes DOCX-to-PDF conversion producing pages that Acrobat cannot display when text effects are turned off. (J#GDPIC-1648)
* Fixes kashida-justified right-to-left paragraphs being aligned to the left margin when converting DOCX to PDF. (J#MAMBO-2115)
* Fixes tables inside text boxes and frames not rendering or causing errors when converting OpenDocument files to PDF. (J#MAMBO-2038)
* Fixes the position of the tab after a list number when converting DOCX and legacy DOC files to PDF. (J#MAMBO-2096)
* Fixes a crash when converting certain legacy Word (.doc) files caused by an out-of-range default font index. (J#DP-43)
* Fixes a crash when converting certain Word documents to PDF in 32-bit (x86) applications. (J#MAMBO-2087)
* Fixes a crash when converting Word documents containing an IF mail-merge field that resolves to an empty result. (J#MAMBO-2076)
* Fixes an exception when loading a Word document that contains an empty custom XML part. (J#MAMBO-2067)
* Fixes an exception when rendering table cells where all text falls outside the cell boundary. (J#MAMBO-2065)
* Fixes an issue parsing dropdown fields in Office documents. (J#MAMBO-2026)
* Fixes an issue parsing fake encrypted XLS files. (J#MAMBO-1998)
* Fixes an issue when recovering malformed PPTX documents. (J#GDPIC-1644)
* Fixes checkbox character rendering with font substitution. (J#MAMBO-2016)
* Fixes crashes when converting ODT documents containing certain merged-cell tables or graphic frames. (J#MAMBO-2071)
* Fixes DOCX repair so footers stored with an invalid hdr root element are corrected to ftr. (J#MAMBO-2078)
* Fixes DOCX to PDF conversion that incorrectly merged two separate paragraphs onto the same line. (J#MAMBO-2095)
* Fixes EMF metafile validation rejecting valid files that contain padding bytes after the end-of-file record. (J#MAMBO-2056)
* Fixes incorrect line wrapping of line-ending punctuation in Word-to-PDF conversion. (J#MAMBO-2101)
* Fixes incorrect page numbers in converted Word documents by honoring the section starting page number and format. (J#MAMBO-2081)
* Fixes incorrect table inside borders when converting legacy DOC documents to DOCX. (J#MAMBO-2082)
* Fixes incorrect text color in Word documents where a text-fill effect should take precedence over the legacy color property. (J#MAMBO-2104)
* Fixes invalid image stream exception. (J#MAMBO-2077)
* Fixes kerning not being applied to text runs when defined at paragraph level in Word documents. (J#MAMBO-2053)
* Fixes line breaking of right-to-left text embedded in left-to-right paragraphs when converting Word documents to PDF. (J#MAMBO-2045)
* Fixes misplaced cell text, page placement and nested table position for floating tables in Word-to-PDF conversion. (J#MAMBO-2033)
* Fixes missing spacing before a numbered paragraph when the preceding paragraph is not part of the list. (J#MAMBO-2062)
* Fixes MSG conversion when an email contains an embedded message attachment. (J#GDPIC-1634)
* Fixes MSG files with custom IPM.Note subclasses (e.g. archived emails) being reported as an unknown format. (J#GDPIC-1621)
* Fixes ODT tables losing their header row. (J#MAMBO-2074)
* Fixes paragraph indent conversion issues from old Word documents. (J#MAMBO-2031)
* Fixes positioning and text rendering of shape groups, including nested groups, when converting Word documents to PDF. (J#MAMBO-2079)
* Fixes PowerPoint to PDF conversion failure caused by a malformed hyperlink address in a slide. (J#MAMBO-2107)
* Fixes regressions caused by switching to .NET 10. (J#MAMBO-2030)
* Fixes several issues when processing Word documents in WASM. (J#MAMBO-2055)
* Fixes stray equals signs and lost formatting when viewing emails whose lines end with a single line feed. (J#GDPIC-1652)
* Fixes text highlight colors being dropped when converting ODT documents to PDF. (J#MAMBO-2039)
* Fixes text-frame alignment in Office documents, honoring paragraph justification, indentation, and frame positioning.
* Fixes XLSX-to-PDF conversion failures for files with malformed external links. (J#GDPIC-1641)
* Fixes a buffer position mismatch when parsing RTF documents. (J#MAMBO-2029)

#### Pdf

* Deprecates the Adobe.PPKMS signature mode; it now produces standard detached CMS signatures. (J#GDPDF-1524)
* Adds deferred two-phase signing so documents can be signed by external and third-party signing services. (J#GDPDF-1524)
* Adds direct tagged PDF emission during DOCX conversion for improved accessibility. (J#PDFA-94, J#PDFA-93)
* Adds document timestamping and LTV retrofitting for extending the validity of already-signed documents. (J#GDPDF-1524)
* Adds DWS account sign-in, automatic guest access, and durable usage reporting to the Nutrient CLI PDF conversion commands. (J#DWS-331)
* Adds PAdES B-LT and B-LTA signature levels that embed validation material for long-term signature validity. (J#GDPDF-1524)
* Adds PDF/UA-1 validation to check whether a PDF conforms to the PDF/UA accessibility standard. (J#NAT-178)
* Adds PKCS#11 support for signing with hardware security modules, USB tokens, and smartcards on all platforms. (J#GDPDF-1524)
* Adds ECDSA certificate support for creating PDF digital signatures. (J#GDPDF-1524)
* Adds support for reading and validating document timestamp signatures. (J#GDPDF-1524)
* Adds a configurable media-load timeout for HTML and email to PDF conversion, bounding how long a slow or unreachable external resource can delay the output. (J#DV-536)
* Adds a Sanitize API to remove metadata, annotations, attachments, scripts, and other hidden data from PDF documents.
* Adds language configuration support for MSG and EML email format processing. (J#MAMBO-2050)
* Adds new InstantJsonRenderTheme setting to support rendering annotations using the same visual style as other Nutrient products. (J#NAT-396)
* Adds support for converting between Instant JSON and GdPicture XMP Annotations. (J#NAT-406)
* Adds support for exporting Instant JSON. (J#NAT-397)
* Improves PDF/A and PDF/UA conversion output file structure consistency. (J#PDFA-98)
* Improves PDF metadata handling and validation. (J#PDFA-83)
* Improves PDF signing with a redesigned engine providing specific error reporting and cross-platform support. (J#GDPDF-1524)
* Improves PDF to Markdown conversion performance.
* Improves heading and table detection.
* Improves HTML to PDF conversion stability. (J#DV-536)
* Improves PDF rendering for specific form configurations. (J#DV-777)
* Improves PDF/A conversion stability. (J#GDPDF-1519)
* Changes the Producer and Creator metadata of generated PDF documents from "GdPicture.NET" to "Nutrient SDK". (J#NAT-460)
* Enables change tracking for Instant JSON exports by default. (J#NAT-394)
* Removes SHA-1 for creating new signatures; verifying existing SHA-1 signatures is still supported. (J#GDPDF-1524)
* Fixes a minor issue in PDF to HTML font processing. (J#NAT-433)
* Fixes Fixes parsing of PDFs with a corrupt cross-reference (xref) table. (J#GDPDF-1512)
* Fixes font resource handling in PDF/A conversion for specific content configurations. (J#PDFA-102)
* Fixes empty embedded file handling when merging PDF documents. (J#GDPDF-1520)
* Fixes validation of documents with multiple signatures so they verify correctly in Adobe Acrobat. (J#GDPDF-1524)
* Fixes a crash during multi-threaded PDF OCR when saving and closing the document from the OcrPagesDone callback. (J#GDPDF-1516)
* Fixes an exception when importing Instant JSON containing form fields with widget annotations that have a border style but no border color. (J#GDPDF-1518)
* Fixes an invalid CIDSet on subset fonts with a non-identity CID-to-GID map during PDF/A-1 conversion. (J#PDFA-96)
* Fixes DrawArc drawing a 180-degree arc slightly rotated, which misaligned the semicircle's endpoints. (J#GDPDF-1511)
* Fixes font width handling in PDF/A conversion for specific content configurations. (J#PDFA-87)
* Fixes HTML and email to PDF conversion hangs on .NET Framework and low-core-count machines. (J#DV-737)
* Fixes incorrect RDF about attribute handling in PDF metadata. (J#PDFA-88)
* Fixes loading of PDF objects whose cross-reference entries contain an invalid zero offset. (J#GDPDF-1522)
* Fixes PDF document signing failure on Windows 11 when running under .NET Framework. (J#GDPDF-1504)
* Fixes PDF layer flattening in specific content configurations. (J#GDPDF-1525)
* Fixes PDF/A-1 conversion of scanned documents rendering as a black page caused by a shared soft mask. (J#PDFA-96)
* Fixes rendering of text form fields in specific configurations. (J#GDPDF-1493)
* Fixes XMP metadata generation when embedding invoice data for specific invoice profiles. (J#GDPDF-1523)
* Fixes large images failing to process when added to PDF by automatically tiling them. (J#GDPIC-1281)
* Fixes minor PDF/A and PDF/UA validation issues.
* Fixes a potential crash in font subset generation when processing certain font metrics tables. (J#PDFA-81)

#### Templating

* Adds Excel (.xlsx) template processing to the Office templater with row loops, image insertion, and cell typing. (J#OFTAPI-21)
* Adds PowerPoint (PPTX) templating with placeholders, loops, conditionals, tables, and images to the Office Templater. (J#OFTAPI-20)
* Fixes Excel template processing failing with an internal error when a section marker shares a cell with other content. (J#OFTAPI-24)
* Fixes duplicate row references in a generated Excel workbook when a template loop repeats more than one row. (J#OFTAPI-24)
* Fixes inverted conditions in Office templates being ignored when a run, paragraph, or table row prefix is used. (J#OFTAPI-23)
* Fixes Office template conditional sections inside table cells rendering empty when the condition is false. (J#DP-47)

#### Viewers

* Fixes the licensing feature trace (LicenseManager.TraceFeatures) recording nothing in trial mode, and never recording the features used by the WPF viewer controls.
* Fixes GdViewer running on WinForms runtimes lookup.
